title: helm-private-values-init-hooks-templating-upgrade-rollback: stabilize templating & init-job rollback
author: Aisha Patel
description: Motivation: Private Helm chart deployments have continued to diverge across on-prem and VPC installs due to brittle values templating and init-job hooks during upgrades. This PR standardizes the values.schema.json for the private chart, introduces templating helpers for user-supplied nodeSelectors/tolerations, and hardens the init-job upgrade/rollback hooks to be idempotent and tolerant of partially-applied migrations. Summary of changes: 1) values.schema.json: expanded schema with clearer union types for encryption, kms, and network settings; added 'oneOf' rules for mutually exclusive postgres/backups; better documentation string fields to aid helm linting and IDE autocompletion. 2) Templating helpers: introduced _helpers.tpl snippets for optional fields (nodeSelector/tolerations/kmsAnnotations) to reduce repeated conditional logic across templates. 3) Init-job hooks: refactored init jobs into a single template with a 'phase' value (pre-upgrade, post-upgrade, rollback) and added safe-guards: --wait-for-pods, idempotent apply steps, and explicit rollback markers in ConfigMap for multi-step upgrades. 4) Rollback workflow: added a dedicated rollback hook that runs only when an annotated release indicates a previous successful migration; it will skip if no migration marker present to avoid accidental data manipulation. 5) Validation tooling: added scripts/helm/validate-values.sh and a CI job to run schema validation against a set of example values files (onprem, vpc, and minimal). Backwards compatibility: preserved previous paths and environment variable names; the schema is additive and includes deprecation notices for legacy keys (telemetry -> observability). Testing: unit templates linted, integration upgrade/rollback scenarios exercised in CI with a simulated k3s cluster, manual verification on a private staging cluster. Rollout plan: merge to main, cut a patch release v2.14.1 for Private Helm, and notify customers in the upgrade notes; follow up with a small CLI helper to migrate deprecated keys. Checklist: [x] values schema expanded and documented, [x] templating helpers added, [x] init-job hooks refactored and made idempotent, [x] rollback hook implemented with safety checks, [x] tests added and CI passing, [x] release notes drafted. Related: ENG-8421 (Private installer upgrade regressions), ENG-8493 (Helm chart templating cleanup).
